title: PMT: Plain Mask Transformer for Image and Video Segmentation with Frozen Vision Encoders
mechanism: Lightweight Plain Mask Decoder mimicking EoMT's last blocks runs on a frozen vision foundation model.
evidence: R: matches frozen-encoder SOTA on image benchmarks, up to 3x faster; video on par with fine-tuned methods. No small-data evidence.
adaptation: Frozen DINOv3 ViT-L (or DINOv2) at 1024 px + PMD + full-res refinement head; aimed at E1: a frozen encoder cannot overfit 478 cells from 5 sources, so half-cut/scuff cells stay nearer the pretraining distribution.
min_experiment: Arm frozen ViT-L + PMD + refinement; baseline house PF; metric E1 crack relF1@2 and E1 inactive IoU; kill if E1 relF1@2 < 0.45 and E1 inactive < 0.24.
prior_overlap: Partial: frozen linear probes of small DINOv3/DINOv2 encoders showed no gain. A mask decoder on frozen ViT-L at 1024 is not the same mechanism; open but scored lower for that reason.

alt_notes.adaptation: Frozen DINOv2 (DINOv3 if OK) ViT-L + PMD + full-res head at 1024; aimed at E1, since a frozen encoder cannot overfit 478 cells from 5 sources.
alt_notes.min_experiment: PMT frozen ViT-L vs house PF; metrics E1 crack relF1@2 and E1 inactive IoU only; kill if E1 relF1@2 < 0.45 and E1 inactive < 0.24.
